name: Cathy Goodman

career.title: EMEA Enterprise and Industry Senior Sales Manager

education: BA Hons 2:1, English and History, De Montfort University, 1989 to 1992
biography:
30 years experience in sales, driving new business and deeper engagement with a wide range of customers and sales channels within the IT sector.  I am highly driven, have consistently performed within many different environments and have built up a range of transferable skills including:

•	Managing cross functional virtual teams on a global basis to drive growth and maximise  potential opportunity with strategic customers, balancing global consistency and standard practice with local focus and cultural integrity.   

•	Developing and managing sales channels within managed services, hosting, data networking, voice and mobile sectors.  I particularly enjoy engaging with my customers at a level where I can become part of their virtual team, collaborating at a partner level and growing business by focusing on their immediate business priorities and growth opportunities.

At Equinix, I currently manage a fast growing team, where the location and proximity to cloud and content ecosystems is starting to change the strategic relevance of the data centre and be seen as a competitive advantage.
